The Harbourside tram extension will open in late March rather than January, the regional transit authority said on Tuesday, blaming a shortage of signalling components from its main supplier. Testing on the 4.2-kilometre section between Mill Quay and the university campus has been suspended until the parts arrive. The authority said the delay would not affect fares or the planned frequency of service, and that the replacement bus route introduced last autumn would keep running in the meantime. Shop owners along the route, who had hoped for more foot traffic before the spring, said they had not been told of the delay before the announcement.
